title: Hinomori Shizuku — Enamored Of Flower Stitches〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: MORE MORE HOUSE

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Hello, everyone!
Thank you for joining us again today.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: MORE MORE JUMP! is now streaming live!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Today, we're going to have Shizuku teach us how to embroider, like we announced the other day.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I hope some of you use this opportunity to take it up. Those of you who are ready to sew are welcome to join us.

rows.Speaker: Comments
rows.Line:
<Okay!>
<I love embroidering, so I've been really excited about this stream!>
<I borrowed my grandma's sewing kit!>

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Thank you all very much!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I promise to make things as easy to understand as I can, so let's do our best together.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: So, it's time to begin Shizuku Hinomori's Embroidering Class.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Let's get started!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: We have two types of stitches on today's agenda.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Once you've gotten the hang of them, we'll try embroidering a simple design together. I'll announce which designs we'll be using in a little bit, so please stay tuned.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Anyway, let's begin with our first stitch...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
*Nod*
Very good. You're all doing an excellent job.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: So, next, let's put the outline and satin stitches we just covered into practice by embroidering a simple design.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Which will be a four-leaf clover.
It's mostly very simple, but there are a couple difficult sections. So, it should be a fun challenge.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Here is what it will look like.
Please feel free to use it for reference, everyone.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: The leaves will be made using satin stitches, while the stem will be made using an outline stitch.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Wow, Shizuku, your clover's so beautiful.

rows.Speaker: Comments
rows.Line:
<It looks storebought...>
<Your clover's so cute, Shizuku!>

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Hehe. Thank you, everyone.
I hope you all get to finish your clovers before our stream ends.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Alright, I'm gonna make mine look just like hers!

rows.Speaker: Comments
rows.Line:
<I dunno...>
<This doesn't seem like your cup of tea, Minori.>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
What?!
But I did fine when we practiced just now, so it'll turn out okay!
Several dozen minutes later

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: How are your clovers coming along?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Wait, are we out of time already?! No, I'm still nowhere near finished!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Yeah, but it still looks pretty good.
You should show her your progress.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
How about I go first?
Can you take a look, Ms. Shizuku?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Of course♪
Yes, this is very tidy work...
Your clover looks nicely balanced.

rows.Speaker: Comments
rows.Line:
<That's amazing, Haruka...!>
<You looked like a pro. You didn't hesitate for a second.>
<Does this mean she also has a talent for embroidery?!>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Hehe. Thank you, everyone.
I appreciate the compliments.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Can you take a look at mine next...?!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Okay. I know you didn't get a chance to finish, but your leaves are beautifully made.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Th-They are?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, it's clear that you took your time and carefully put in each stitch.

rows.Speaker: Comments
rows.Line:
<Yeah, you did a pretty good job.>
<Nice work, Minori!>
<We know you did your best!>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Th-Thank goodness!
I really appreciate it, you guys!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: She usually does pretty well when she takes things slow and steady.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Anyway, can you take a look at mine next?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Okay, Airi... Oh, this is incredible!
Not only does is it well-formed, your stitchwork is beautiful too!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
I actually do a lot of sewing.
Replacing buttons, fixing sleeves, you name it.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: That certainly explains why it looks professionally done. Oh, you even included a little butterfly!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I had a little time at the end, so I decided to throw in something extra. It's a nice touch, right?

rows.Speaker: Comments
rows.Line:
<A perfect clover and a butterfly...?!>
<You're way too good at this, Airi...!>
<You should list this as one of your talents on your profile.>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Thanks for the comments, you guys.
Now I'm really glad that I went all out.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I really am impressed, since this was basically the first time you three tried embroidery.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Now that I'm seeing what we all made, I'm starting to think that we're pretty good at these kinds of things.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah, I had a lot of fun watching my work come together little by little!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Hehe. Me too.
It's sort of how we do things, isn't it?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Oh...
That unexpected nugget is unfortunately our cue to wrap things up for today.

rows.Speaker: Comments
rows.Line:
<Your embroidery class was so much fun!>
<Please do a second one soon.>
<This was my first time embroidering, but I wanna try it again!>

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Thank you...!
We hope that you take pictures of what you made and share them on social media.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Anyway, we'll see you again!

rows.Speaker: Haruka, Minori & Airi
rows.Line: See you soon!
